author: Hermes
question: A balanced three-phase star-connected load has 9 ohm per phase. What is the equivalent delta-connected resistance per phase?
solution: For the same load, R_delta = 3 x R_star = 3 x 9 = 27 ohm per phase. Topic (star-delta transformation, three-phase circuits) is in Section 2 of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Electric Circuits
